import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Load the data
data = """amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 10))
fig.suptitle('Transaction Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Plot 1: Transaction Amount by Type
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", n_colors=len(df['transaction_type'].unique()))
sns.barplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', y='amount', ax=ax1, palette=colors)
ax1.set_title('Transaction Amount by Type')
ax1.set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
ax1.set_ylabel('Amount ($)')
for i, v in enumerate(df.groupby('transaction_type')['amount'].mean()):
    ax1.text(i, v + 10, f'${v:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# Plot 2: Distribution of Transaction Amounts
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
sns.histplot(data=df, x='amount', bins=10, kde=True, ax=ax2, color='steelblue')
ax2.set_title('Distribution of Transaction Amounts')
ax2.set_xlabel('Amount ($)')
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency')

# Plot 3: Transactions by Hour of Day
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
hour_counts = df.groupby('hour_of_day').size().reset_index(name='count')
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='hour_of_day', y='amount', hue='transaction_type', 
                s=100, ax=ax3, palette='Set2')
ax3.set_title('Transaction Amount vs Hour of Day')
ax3.set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
ax3.set_ylabel('Amount ($)')
ax3.set_xlim(0, 24)
ax3.legend(title='Type', loc='upper right')

# Plot 4: Transaction Type Distribution (Pie Chart)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
type_counts = df['transaction_type'].value_counts()
colors_pie = sns.color_palette("pastel", n_colors=len(type_counts))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(type_counts, labels=type_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors_pie,
                                    explode=[0.05] * len(type_counts))
ax4.set_title('Transaction Type Distribution')

# Add summary statistics as text
summary_text = f"Total Transactions: {len(df)}\n"
summary_text += f"Total Amount: ${df['amount'].sum():.2f}\n"
summary_text += f"Avg Amount: ${df['amount'].mean():.2f}\n"
summary_text += f"Fraud Cases: {df['is_fraud'].sum()}"

fig.text(0.98, 0.02, summary_text, fontsize=10, ha='right', va='bottom',
         bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.5))

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
